info.bio:
White Zombie fue una banda de industrial groove metal. El nombre está sacado de la película White Zombie de 1932, protagonizada por Bela Lugosi.

Establecidos en New York, White Zombie originalmente fue una banda de Noise Rock en la misma categoría que Sonic Youth. Thurston Moore de Sonic Youth y el icono del rock alternativo Kurt Cobain han confesado ser fanáticos de sus primeros trabajos.

scenes.name: Speed y thrash metal
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: La escena «street» de Los Ángeles cruza el hardcore (Bad Brains, Black Flag) con el glam-metal. A partir de una intuición de D.R.I., Metallica inventan el speed-metal: del thrash de Kill 'Em All a la elegancia casi clásica de Master Of Puppets. Megadeth, Slayer (puente entre el black metal de Venom y el death metal), Exciter, la escena de San Francisco (Death Angel, Exodus, Testament), Anthrax y White Zombie en Nueva York, y Sepultura, que lo convierten en lenguaje universal (Roots).

podcast.title: The Crow: City of Angels Soundtrack Contribution (1996)
podcast.body: White Zombie was featured on the soundtrack for *The Crow: City of Angels*, the 1996 sequel to *The Crow*. This collection was considered "pretty much as good as the first one" and included other prominent bands of the era. "Bush, Corn, Deftones, E-Pop, White Zombie, Filter."

podcast.title: Student Suspended for White Zombie T-Shirt with "666" – Deemed "Disturbing Biblical Reference"
podcast.body: A student was suspended for wearing a White Zombie t-shirt that bore the number "666," which school administrators classified as a "disturbing biblical reference." "A student was suspended for wearing a White Zombie t-shirt with the number '666,' considered a 'disturbing biblical reference.'"

xref.title: `Cafe Flesh` Sample (1982)
xref.body: The distinct moaning in Rob Zombie and White Zombie's song "More Human Than Human" is sampled from the 1982 sci-fi movie `Cafe Flesh`, which depicts a post-nuclear world where most surviving humans become ill if they attempt sex, leading to live sex shows for their benefit. "The sample is taken from a 1982 sci-fi movie called Cafe Flesh. After the world is nearly annihilated in a nuclear war, they're surviving humans find that they get sick when they try to have sex. The moaning comes from someone participating in a live sex show conducted for the benefit of those humans who can't have sex anymore."

xref.title: Godfathers of Goth - Enduring Influence
xref.body: Bauhaus is widely recognized as one of the founding groups and pioneers of the original British Goth movement. Their distinctive glamour, energy, art school sensibilities, and attitude of "doom and gloom" had a profound and infectious impact globally, influencing numerous dark bands, including Nine Inch Nails, Marilyn Manson, White Zombie, Courtney Love, and The Smashing Pumpkins. "The band often described as the Godfathers of Goth."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Influenced by Bauhaus
xref.body: Nine Inch Nails' existence is attributed to the prior influence of Bauhaus, with their sound and image shaped by the Goth pioneers. "if it weren't for them, there probably wouldn't be a nine inch nails or a Maryland Manson or a white zombie."
